verdict.rationale: Docusaurus ships an official CLI (`docusaurus build`, `docusaurus start`, `create-docusaurus`) that runs non-interactively and is confirmed by a runtime probe to scaffold a full site headlessly with no account/keys needed, making CI automation clearly supported for build/deploy pipelines. However, community reports concrete caveats for CI usage at scale — GitHub Actions timeouts on 30+ minute builds and out-of-memory crashes on large doc sets — showing real friction in automated/CI contexts. Missing for 10: no first-party CI-specific guidance/GitHub Action, and no evidence addressing the reported performance/resource issues in CI environments.
